name: dsh-file-to-chat
description: Annotate a selection in the DeepSeek Harness right-sidebar document preview or in any message of the conversation — text, Excel cell ranges, Word/PDF pages — and send the quote plus your note into the current chat. Adds a right-click file tree menu (send content, send path, copy path, open with the default application) and folds sent quotes into a capsule in the transcript.
